assessment: Already public; suitable as a public tutorial distribution repository after correcting current legacy network/Codex overclaims and adding explicit license/source attribution. No detected secret or live payment material in reviewed tracked blobs/history; this is not permission or advice to make either application source repository public.

remediation.issue: Current copy labels residential IP as cleanest and suggests network labels predict account first impression; no proof.
remediation.action: Rewrite as network diagnostics, no risk score or approval promise; official region eligibility separate; redact results/screenshots before sharing.

remediation.issue: Current copy oversimplifies Codex payment to ChatGPT subscription and claims stable geography reduces risk without evidence; calls untested process practical.
remediation.action: Separate ChatGPT plan inclusion, usage credits and API billing based on fresh official sources; remove unsupported risk claims; distinguish visible checkout/order flow from real transaction validation.

remediation.issue: No LICENSE; content public visibility does not establish reuse permissions. Existing four images have generation prompts/hash attribution but no explicit reuse boundary.
remediation.action: Add clear terms for owner-authored text/scripts and separate generated-image/third-party brand exclusions, attribution and contribution terms; do not imply third-party materials have been relicensed.

remediation.issue: Earlier public versions contain unverified transaction and lower-risk claims, corrected on main in 2018bb4.
remediation.action: Keep factual correction notice and link current pages; do not silently rewrite full history unless separately needed for a real secret.

limitations: No standalone gitleaks executable available; audited with explicit key/token/private-path/PII/payment-endpoint patterns and manual content review.
No real transaction, credential redemption, account access or legal rights verification performed.
Image generator attribution is recorded by repository receipts; authorship/third-party right clearance is not independently provable from pixels.
Repository/settings endpoints not exposing private GitHub secrets or removed unreferenced history were outside scope.

license_recommendation.original_code: MIT, scoped to owner-authored tools/scripts, include full license text.
license_recommendation.original_text: CC BY 4.0, scoped to owner-authored tutorials; preserve attribution and mark changes.
license_recommendation.generated_images: Separate disclosure: CC BY 4.0 only to extent of licensor-held rights; no promise of exclusive AI-output copyright or third-party right clearance.
license_recommendation.third_party_material: Third-party quotations, logos, platform screenshots and linked resources retain their own terms; not relicensed by repository license.

security_recommendation.action: Enable basic repository secret scanning alerts and push protection if the public repository entitlement supports them, then GET-readback. Do not enable paid advanced security or organization-wide settings as a side effect.
security_recommendation.basis: Reasonable reversible leak prevention for a public documentation repository; not an assurance of exhaustive detection.
